From ff3c664505bf8a8334bca5045e87b85cfe4d2277 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Neil Greatorex <neil@fatboyfat.co.uk>
Date: Fri, 18 Apr 2014 14:19:49 +0200
Subject: [PATCH] irqchip: armada-370-xp: Fix releasing of MSIs

Store the value of d->hwirq in a local variable as the real value is wiped out
by calling irq_dispose_mapping. Without this patch, the armada_370_xp_free_msi
function would always free MSI#0, no matter what was passed to it.

Fixes: 31f614edb726fcc4d5aa0f2895fbdec9b04a3ca4 ('irqchip: armada-370-xp: implement MSI support')
Cc: <stable@vger.kernel.org> # v3.13+
Signed-off-by: Neil Greatorex <neil@fatboyfat.co.uk>
Link: https://lkml.kernel.org/r/1397823593-1932-4-git-send-email-thomas.petazzoni@free-electrons.com
Signed-off-by: Thomas Petazzoni <thomas.petazzoni@free-electrons.com>
Link: https://lkml.kernel.org/r/1397823593-1932-4-git-send-email-thomas.petazzoni@free-electrons.com
Signed-off-by: Jason Cooper <jason@lakedaemon.net>

diff --git a/drivers/irqchip/irq-armada-370-xp.c b/drivers/irqchip/irq-armada-370-xp.c
index 78b0ac9129d7..868d11bc00d2 100644
--- a/drivers/irqchip/irq-armada-370-xp.c
+++ b/drivers/irqchip/irq-armada-370-xp.c
@@ -158,8 +158,10 @@ static void armada_370_xp_teardown_msi_irq(struct msi_chip *chip,
 					   unsigned int irq)
 {
 	struct irq_data *d = irq_get_irq_data(irq);
+	unsigned long hwirq = d->hwirq;
+
 	irq_dispose_mapping(irq);
-	armada_370_xp_free_msi(d->hwirq);
+	armada_370_xp_free_msi(hwirq);
 }
 
 static int armada_370_xp_check_msi_device(struct msi_chip *chip, struct pci_dev *dev,
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

**File: `drivers/irqchip/irq-armada-370-xp.c`**
- A local variable `hwirq` is introduced to store the value of `d->hwirq`.
- The call to `armada_370_xp_free_msi` is modified to use the local variable `hwirq` instead of directly using `d->hwirq`.

### Relationships
The modification addresses a bug where the original implementation would always free MSI#0 due to the value of `d->hwirq` being overwritten by the `irq_dispose_mapping` function. By storing the value in a local variable before calling `irq_dispose_mapping`, the correct MSI can be freed based on the original value passed to the function. This change ensures that the `armada_370_xp_free_msi` function behaves correctly and frees the appropriate MSI.

Here is the commit message:
irqchip: armada-370-xp: Fix releasing of MSIs

Store the value of d->hwirq in a local variable as the real value is wiped out
by calling irq_dispose_mapping. Without this patch, the armada_370_xp_free_msi
function would always free MSI#0, no matter what was passed to it.

Fixes: 31f614edb726fcc4d5aa0f2895fbdec9b04a3ca4 ('irqchip: armada-370-xp: implement MSI support')
Cc: <stable@vger.kernel.org> # v3.13+
Signed-off-by: Neil Greatorex <neil@fatboyfat.co.uk>
Link: https://lkml.kernel.org/r/1397823593-1932-4-git-send-email-thomas.petazzoni@free-electrons.com
Signed-off-by: Thomas Petazzoni <thomas.petazzoni@free-electrons.com>
Link: https://lkml.kernel.org/r/1397823593-1932-4-git-send-email-thomas.petazzoni@free-electrons.com
Signed-off-by: Jason Cooper <jason@lakedaemon.net>

Here is the root cause:
The bug occurs because the value of `d->hwirq` is overwritten by the `irq_dispose_mapping` function before it can be used to free the correct MSI. As a result, the `armada_370_xp_free_msi` function always attempts to free MSI#0, regardless of the actual MSI that should be freed.

Here is the patch:
 
 static void armada_370_xp_teardown_msi_irq(struct msi_chip *chip,
 					   unsigned int irq)
 {
 	struct irq_data *d = irq_get_irq_data(irq);
+	unsigned long hwirq = d->hwirq;
+
 	irq_dispose_mapping(irq);
-	armada_370_xp_free_msi(d->hwirq);
+	armada_370_xp_free_msi(hwirq);
 }

The bug occurs because the value of `d->hwirq` is overwritten by the `irq_dispose_mapping` function before it can be used to free the correct MSI. As a result, the `armada_370_xp_free_msi` function always attempts to free MSI#0, regardless of the actual MSI that should be freed.

Code statements information:
The code statements that lead to the bug are:
```c

irq_dispose_mapping(irq);
armada_370_xp_free_msi(d->hwirq);
```
Reason:
The value of `d->hwirq` is overwritten by the `irq_dispose_mapping` function before it can be used to free the correct MSI. This results in the `armada_370_xp_free_msi` function always attempting to free MSI#0, regardless of the actual MSI that should be freed.

The code statements that fix the bug are:
```c

armada_370_xp_free_msi(hwirq);
```
Reason:
By storing the value of `d->hwirq` in a local variable `hwirq` before calling `irq_dispose_mapping`, the correct MSI value is preserved. This allows the `armada_370_xp_free_msi` function to free the appropriate MSI instead of always freeing MSI#0.
